rationale: I read the complete held EO 8093 (4 FR 1649, Apr 17, 1939): revokes EO 6119 (California withdrawal) as to the remainder of the lands, effective upon the official filing of the resurvey plat. It is a self-executing revocation whose effect depended on a future filing event; its own-term (effective on plat filing) is a trigger, not an ending. No held record shows the plat filing or any later action, so I cannot say whether the order's operative effect has occurred (thus ended by completion) or remains pending. No ACT:, TERM: or ACTOR_TEXT: basis for NO; no CURRENT predicate for YES. Blocked pending the plat filing record.
